question_text: Suppose, you are Mahsin/Mahsina. Your friend
stimulus: Shafi/Shafia wants to know about "The importance of Tree plantation". Now, write a dialogue between you and your friend about it. 10 Subject Code : 1 0 7 (i) We are very much serious (ii) We are very much sincere (iii) We are indifferent to our duties about keeping our environment good (iv) We are acting wisely (f) In paragraph 2 the author says, "We are leading our planet towards a great disaster". What does the author meanby this? (i) We are willingly doing harm to our environment (ii) We are going to face a huge calamity for our own deeds (iii) We will have to change our environment (iv) We will destroy our environment (g) What is the main purpose of the author of this passage? (i) To show people the real picture of our environment (ii) To make people more knowledgeable (iii To threat people about their unjust act (iv) To make people conscious about the importance of keeping our environment in a good condition
